commit.message:
test(web-benchmark): re-record agent recordings for @e2e-dev/web 0.12 (#833)

#774 bumped @e2e-dev/web to 0.12.0. The cache key carries the engine minor,
so every committed entry sat under an old hash and the strict web agent job
failed 25 steps with REPLAY_STALE. Re-recorded live; old entries deleted.

failed 25 steps with REPLAY_STALE. Re-recorded live; old entries deleted.
